Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
The standard Carry-On Expandable ($495 on sale) is designed to fit in virtually any overhead bin while offering an expandable zipper for 32% extra capacity when needed.
The Large Carry-On Expandable ($525 on sale) maximizes interior space to give you the largest carry-on capacity possible, ideal if you want to stretch your trips up to a week without checking a bag.
If your primary focus is effortless, everyday travel that adheres strictly to standard overhead size limits, the standard Carry-On Expandable is your best choice. If you prefer extra packing room and want to avoid checking luggage on longer journeys, the Large Carry-On Expandable offers the highest capacity value.
